page: Microsoft Azure D8ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture and hypervised by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is driven by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor featuring 4 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs via multithreading. It provides 32.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core) accompanied by 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. Modern vector and cryptographic instructions are supported, including AVX-512 (f, vnni, bf16), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance includes a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD for fast local temporary storage, while GPUs are not present.

Benchmark data reflects strong single-thread performance, highlighted by top-quartile results in stress-ng single-core (3079.78) and Geekbench single-core (1999.0), as well as strong Geekbench text processing (2665.0). Multi-core benchmarks sit consistently within the average category, showing a Geekbench multi-core score of 7627.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 14474.73. Compression throughput is solid, yielding 29.38 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip and 53.71 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

Memory bandwidth measurements demonstrate mixed characteristics, sustaining 607.6 GB/sec for small cached blocks (16 KB) and 28.76 GB/sec for large block writes (256 MB), but falling to the bottom 25% for uncached read operations at 38.94 GB/sec. Large-scale memory latency and streaming bandwidth constrain performance during intensive tasks like medium 7B LLM prompt processing (23.56 tokens/sec, falling in the bottom 25%). However, it achieves stable average throughput across Redis SET operations (11.53 million ops/sec) and static web serving (12.28 GB/sec).

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, integrated high-speed NVMe storage, and solid single-core metrics, Microsoft Azure D8ads_v6 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for standard workloads that do not demand persistent high uncached memory bandwidth. It is well matched for web serving, middle-tier enterprise applications, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and caching database layers.
description: Microsoft Azure D8ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor offering 4 dedicated physical cores, 8 vCPUs, and 32.0 GB of RAM. The instance incorporates 472 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 extensions and cryptographic acceleration. Benchmark results show strong single-core performance alongside average multi-core and general computational execution. Although uncached memory read bandwidth is comparatively low at 38.94 GB/sec, the configuration excels in single-threaded responsiveness and general throughput, delivering 11.53 million Redis SET operations per second and 12.28 GB/sec in static web serving. Without dedicated accelerators, the instance provides cost-efficient, well-rounded performance for web serving, build environments, microservices, and local cache-intensive applications.
